2610.04138.title: Dual-Scale Relational Graph Transformers for Ecosystem-Aware Fraud Detection
2610.04138.paper_summary: Account takeover (ATO) fraud is a growing threat to digital banking, requiring effective detection while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Production systems predominantly rely on tabular models that score sessions in isolation, discarding the relational structure of the underlying interaction network. Although graph-based models exploit relationships among sessions and network entities, they primarily reason over local neighborhoods and therefore capture only part of the problem: fraud risk depends jointly on the local relational structure surrounding a session and the evolving global state of the fraud ecosystem. We present HERMES (HEterogeneous Relational Micro--macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions), a dual-scale architecture that jointly models these complementary scales of information. Micro-GT captures local heterogeneous graph structure through structured, relation-aware attention over a temporally safe session neighborhood. Complementing this local representation, Macro-GT models ecosystem-level context using non-anticipative climate tokens that summarize fraud dynamics, platform shifts, and infrastructure reuse, together with adaptive class prototypes that track representative fraud and benign session patterns over time. Evaluated on more than 130 million high-risk transaction sessions from a leading U.S. financial institution, HERMES consistently outperforms production and strong graph-based baselines, achieving a 44.44% relative reduction in customer friction and a 24.66% relative improvement in fraud recall over the production system. Ablation and temporal-stability analyses further demonstrate complementary gains from local relational modeling and global ecosystem context across changing fraud regimes.
2610.04138.paper_summary_zh: 帳戶接管（ATO）詐騙對數位銀行構成日益增長的威脅，需要有效的檢測，同時最小化對合法客戶的摩擦。生產系統主要依賴於獨立評分會話的表格模型，忽略了潛在互動網絡的關聯結構。雖然基於圖的模型利用會話和網絡實體之間的關係，但它們主要在局部鄰域中推理，因此僅捕捉到問題的一部分：詐騙風險共同依賴於圍繞會話的局部關聯結構和不斷演變的詐騙生態系統的全球狀態。我們提出了 HERMES（HEterogeneous Relational Micro--macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions），這是一種雙尺度架構，聯合建模這些互補的信息尺度。Micro-GT 通過對時間安全的會話鄰域進行結構化、關係感知的注意力，捕捉局部異質圖結構。作為對這種局部表示的補充，Macro-GT 使用非預期的氣候標記來建模生態系統級別的上下文，這些標記總結了詐騙動態、平台變化和基礎設施重用，並結合自適應類別原型，隨時間跟踪代表性的詐騙和良性會話模式。在對美國一家領先金融機構的超過 1.3 億高風險交易會話進行評估後，HERMES 始終超越生產和強大的基於圖的基準，實現了客戶摩擦相對減少 44.44% 和詐騙召回相對改善 24.66%。消融和時間穩定性分析進一步證明了在變化的詐騙體系下，局部關聯建模和全球生態系統上下文的互補增益。
